_comment: Life skills tab. 15 skills, levels 1-100 by doing them; XP to go from level n to n+1 = lifeSkills.levelXpBase + n x levelXpPerLevel (tuning.json), amounts per action in tuning lifeSkills.xp. Every level adds everyLevel.perLevel to its stat; at 25/50/75/100 you pick one of two perks (stat + value, summed by UWRLifeSkillsComponent::Stat and read where the system is). A perk with waitsFor (the system it needs) isn't in the game yet: the screen doesn't show it and the server won't take it; a tier whose perks all wait isn't shown, a tier with one shows just that one. Remove waitsFor once its system ships. All first drafts.
